fix: Add the row 'ridged -> rib' to config/flora_counted_parts.tsv (beside 'ribbed -> rib' and 'costate -> rib'), so '6-8-ridged' becomes amount 6-8 of rib with container aerial stem. The 'measurement_missing_unit' reason is a misfire on the compound count.

target: acaulescent: a quality of the whole plant, by virtue of its having no evident aerial stem, the leaves and peduncles arising at or near ground level
